## Notes

Bots combine a head, body, and drive from Mk 0 to Mk 3; head sets max instructions (12 to 32) and find range; body sets hand, backpack, and upgrade slots; drive sets speed, recharge time, and battery; upgrades include brain, sensor, speed, and energy.
